author: Capstone team
content: October 28 — CSP capstone documentation update. Added SFI's organization introduction, official website (sfifoundation.com), contacts, and a record of October 22–26 partnership correspondence. Student documentation; not a new client meeting. Next: confirm representative attendance and gather SFI priorities.

author: Jennifer Faye · SFI Foundation
content: October 26 — Client reply. Jennifer appreciated the previous semester's SFI website prototype and confirmed strong interest in continuing with the new student team. She cannot attend the November 2 Electives Fair but a colleague may represent SFI. Attendance and specific website requirements are not yet confirmed. Participants: Jennifer Faye, Katie Salo, John Mortensen, Ruhaan Bansal.

author: Katie Salo · PUSD
content: October 26 — Follow-up to Jennifer, John, and Ruhaan. Katie explained that SFI can RSVP to express interest even without attending the Electives Fair in person. RSVP: https://forms.gle/rU9gojMELnqBm4G17 . Next: coordinate representation or a later meeting.

author: Katie Salo · PUSD
content: October 26 — Partnership invitation. Katie explained that Del Norte's nonprofit website development program is expanding beyond the spring pilot. She invited SFI to meet students, review student work, and discuss a spring 2027 collaboration. Invitation only; scope not agreed.

author: John Mortensen · Del Norte HS
content: October 22 — Initial outreach to SFI. John invited the foundation to renew its student partnership and explore website upgrades, prototypes, possible production pathways, and technology such as AI and data tools. Student capacity and client needs will determine the scope; spring 2027 is the target.
